{{WorldTableTennisChampionshipsEvents|year=2013}}
{{main article|2013 World Table Tennis Championships}}

The '''2013 World Table Tennis Championships mixed doubles''' was the 52nd edition of the mixed doubles championship.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.allabouttabletennis.com/world-table-tennis-championships-medal-winners.html|title=List of Winners|publisher=All About Table Tennis}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ittf.com/museum/WorldChResultsXD.pdf|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120609224957/http://www.ittf.com/museum/WorldChResultsXD.pdf|url-status=dead|archive-date=2012-06-09|title=Mixed doubles results|publisher=International Table Tennis Federation}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://sports123.com/tte/index.html|title=Table Tennis World Championship medal winners|publisher=Sports123|access-date=2018-04-01|archive-date=2018-09-22|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180922055935/http://sports123.com/tte/index.html|url-status=dead}}</ref>

[[Zhang Chao]] and [[Cao Zhen (table tennis)|Cao Zhen]] were the defending champions.<ref>[http://www.ittf.com/ittf_tournaments/ittf_entries_mix_wttc_web.asp?Gender=M&Tour_ID=2190&Mix=1 Entry list]</ref><br />
[[Kim Hyok-Bong]] and [[Kim Jong (table tennis)|Kim Jong]] defeated [[Lee Sang-Su]] and [[Park Young-Sook]] 11–6, 11–8, 11–3, 6–11, 8–11, 11–7 in the final to win the title.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ittf.com/_front_page/ittf_full_story1.asp?ID=31602&Competition_ID=2190&|title=History Making Win in Paris, Kim Hyok Bong and Kim Jong Win Mixed Doubles Crown|date=2013-05-18|work=ittf.com}}</ref>

==Seeds==
Doubles matches will be best of 5 games in qualification matches and best of 7 games in the 128-player sized main draw.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.ittf.com/world_events/wttc_2013/Playing_system_WTTC2013.pdf |title=2013 World TT Championships Playing System |publisher=ITTF |format=PDF |accessdate=11 May 2013}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.ittf.com/ittf_tournaments/ittf_entries_mix_wttc_web.asp?Gender=M&Tour_ID=2190&Seeded_Mix=1&FormParticipants_Sorting=26&FormParticipants_Sorted=& |title=2013 WTTC Seeds&nbsp;– Mixed doubles |work=ittf.com |accessdate=11 May 2013}}</ref>
